title: Chemspyd: an open-source python interface for Chemspeed robotic chemistry and materials platforms

metadata.authors: Seifrid M, Strieth-Kalthoff F, Haddadnia M, Wu TC, Alca E, Bodo L, Arellano-Rubach S, Yoshikawa N, Skreta M, Keunen R, Aspuru-Guzik A

source_summary: Chemspyd is a lightweight, open-source Python package that enables dynamic, modular integration and natural language control of Chemspeed Technologies' laboratory robotic platforms, facilitating flexible automation in laboratory workflows.
abstract: We introduce Chemspyd, a lightweight, open-source Python package for operating the popular laboratory robotic platforms from Chemspeed Technologies. As an add-on to the existing proprietary software suite, Chemspyd enables dynamic communication with the automated platform, laying the foundation for its modular integration into customizable, higher-level laboratory workflows. We show the applicability of Chemspyd in a set of case studies from chemistry and materials science. We demonstrate how the package can be used with large language models to provide a natural language interface. By providing an open-source software interface for a commercial robotic platform, we hope to inspire the development of open interfaces that facilitate the flexible, adaptive integration of existing laboratory equipment into automated laboratories.

methods.value: Development of Chemspyd, a lightweight Python API for Chemspeed platforms, following object-oriented design principles and enabling real-time, adaptive control.

problems.value: Lack of open-source software interfaces for integrating Chemspeed robotic platforms into customizable, higher-level laboratory workflows.

hypotheses.value: An open-source Python package can enable dynamic communication with Chemspeed platforms, facilitating their integration into automated laboratories.

evidence.value: Successful implementation of Chemspyd in experimental case studies from chemistry and materials science, demonstrating its applicability and effectiveness.

conclusions.value: Chemspyd enables the dynamic control of Chemspeed instruments and their seamless integration into custom workflows and automated laboratories.
